title: Cirurgião Dentista - Periodontista
description:
Descrição Sumária do Cargo: Realiza atendimentos especializados voltados à prevenção, diagnóstico e tratamento das doenças periodontais em pacientes encaminhados pela Atenção Básica. Executa procedimentos clínicos e cirúrgicos periodontais, elabora planos terapêuticos conforme protocolos do SUS, orienta pacientes quanto à higiene bucal e cuidados preventivos, contribuindo para a reabilitação da saúde bucal e para a integralidade do atendimento, em conformidade com normas técnicas, assistenciais e éticas da odontologia.

Resumo das principais atividades;

Atuar no Centro de Especialidades Odontológicas (CEO), prestando atendimento especializado em periodontia a pacientes encaminhados pela Atenção Básica; Realizar avaliação clínica, diagnóstico e planejamento do tratamento das doenças periodontais, conforme protocolos do SUS;

Requisitos necessários: Conselho de Classe Ativo/Regularizado e Especialização em Radiologia Odontológica e Imaginologia.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to drive advanced analytics initiatives within our CX Regional Hub. If you are passionate about machine learning, recommendation systems, and transforming sales data into actionable business insights, this opportunity is for you.

Required Technical Skills

  • +3 years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning roles
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Experience with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure ) and data engineering concepts
  • Experience with data visualization tools ( Power BI or Tableau )
  • Hands-on experience building Predictive Models and Recommendation Systems
  • Experience working with sales data and customer behavior analytics
  • Knowledge of Customer Segmentation & Churn Analysis

What You’ll Do

  • Build and deploy machine learning models for personalized product recommendations
  • Develop predictive models to identify churn and lapsed operators
  • Create operator value prediction models using historical secondary sales data
  • Perform deep data exploration and feature engineering to improve model performance
  • Adapt and implement models to support EOTM strategies
  • Collaborate with CX, Sales, Marketing, and Tech teams to align data science solutions with business goals
  • Apply best practices in ML model development, validation, and deployment

Want to change the world? Let us know.

  • Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

title: Estágio de Gastronomia
description:
Apresentação do Cargo:

Apoiar a equipe de culinária nas operações diárias da cozinha, desenvolvendo habilidades técnicas em preparação de alimentos, mise en place e execução de pratos, enquanto aprende sobre segurança alimentar, organização de processos culinários e técnicas gastronômicas aplicadas em ambiente hoteleiro.

Responsabilidades e atividades:

  • Auxiliar no preparo de alimentos (mise en place) conforme orientação dos chefs e cozinheiros;
  • Apoiar na organização e higienização de utensílios, equipamentos e áreas de trabalho;
  • Participar do preparo de pratos sob supervisão da equipe;
  • Auxiliar no recebimento e armazenamento correto de mercadorias;
  • Colaborar na montagem e finalização de pratos;
  • Realizar cortes e preparos básicos de vegetais, carnes e outros ingredientes;
  • Manter a limpeza e organização da cozinha seguindo normas de segurança alimentar;
  • Auxiliar no controle de validade e rotatividade de produtos;
  • Apoiar no abastecimento de buffets quando aplicável;
  • Separar e descartar resíduos conforme procedimentos de sustentabilidade;
  • Acompanhar e aprender técnicas culinárias com a equipe;
  • Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de boas práticas de manipulação de alimentos.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando ensino superior em Gastronomia, Nutrição, Hotelaria ou áreas correlatas;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar no mínimo 6 meses.

title: Arquiteto(a) de Dados IA
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Arquiteto(a) de Dados IA Sênior – Remoto

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Arquiteto(a) de Dados IA . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!

Requisitos essenciais:

  • Ter experiência em Arquitetura de Dados;
  • Ter experiência com IA tradicional (Machine Learning preditivo) e IA generativa (LLMs, agentes, RAG e BI conversacional);
  • Ter experiência nas tecnologias do Google Cloud Platform (GCP) para workloads de dados e IA;
  • Ter inglês fluente com capacidade de participar de reuniões e agendas com fornecedores estrangeiros;
  • Influenciar stakeholders, envolvendo diferentes áreas na adoção das melhores soluções técnicas;
  • Comunicar-se de forma estratégica em fóruns executivos;
  • Equilibrar visão tático-estratégica com execução prática;
  • Colaborar de forma interpessoal com diversas áreas além da arquitetura.

Requisitos adicionais:

  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Criar visões de arquitetura e organizar o ecossistema de Dados e IA (foundation);
  • Direcionar a arquitetura em capabilities de BI conversacional, agentes de IA e IA generativa;

title: Finance Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Finance Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing all financial operations for our Brazil entity, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement across accounting, reporting, and internal controls.

Reporting into the Brazil Controller you will serve as the primary finance lead for Brazil, taking full ownership of local statutory and regulatory obligations while partnering closely with cross-functional and global teams. This is a hands-on leadership role that requires a strong combination of technical accounting expertise, process-driven thinking, and the ability to navigate Brazil's complex regulatory environment.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth setting and is passionate about building robust financial processes from the ground up. You will play a critical role in strengthening our financial foundation in Brazil as SHEIN continues to expand its presence in the region.

This role will be based in our office in São Paulo.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the internalization and implementation of accounting systems , ensuring seamless integration with existing internal controls and financial processes.
  • Build and continuously improve internal controls, financial systems, and processes to guarantee accuracy of financial reporting, integrity of corporate data, compliance with finance governance, and safeguarding of assets.
  • Take accountability for all local statutory, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements (taxes, financial reporting, solicitor account rules, financial controls, and policies), as well as accounting records and financial processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Group and regional teams on matters such as transfer pricing , international mobility, partner tax and accounting issues, direct and indirect taxation.
  • Monitor and navigate the evolving regulatory landscape, staying up to date with IRS, SEC, and other relevant rules and regulations.
  • Build strong relationships with regional auditors and manage the statutory audit process.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of hands-on global or regional accounting experience.
  • CPA or CA certification.
  • Bachelor's Degree;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong self-management skills with proven ability to work independently and resourcefully.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines, managing multiple projects simultaneously with exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience in accounting system implementation and integration projects.

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

This is a high-impact opportunity to work on complex cloud architecture initiatives supporting enterprise customers with performance-sensitive workloads. About Derflan

Derflan is a boutique consulting firm supporting some of the world’s most innovative technology organizations. We specialize in placing experienced professionals in strategic roles where they can drive meaningful impact for global clients.

Our consultants work across cloud, technology, marketing, and operations, helping enterprise teams execute critical initiatives and deliver measurable business results.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.

Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.

Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.

Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.

Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.

Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.

Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).

Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Analista Gestão de Pessoas Sênior (Benefícios)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Atuar na administração do pacote de benefícios, garantindo conformidade legal e alinhamento às políticas internas. Ser responsável pelo relacionamento com fornecedores, negociações contratuais e conferência dos lançamentos na folha de pagamento. Controlar contratos, custos e indicadores, além de conduzir movimentações de beneficiários com precisão. Apoiar auditorias, participa de projetos de melhoria e implantação de novos benefícios e contribui para a comunicação aos colaboradores. Propor melhorias contínuas para aumentar a eficiência, otimizar custos e fortalecer a experiência do empregado.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.

FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.

We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.

What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.

Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team

You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome

Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience

Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction

Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil

How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Start Date: ASAP

We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.

At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.

About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.

Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.

We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.

We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues

  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified

We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones

Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability

If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Company Overview

Created in 2019, Simetrik is a robust B2B platform powered by no code and generative AI. It empowers financial and operational teams by allowing them to automate all reconciliations from start to finish, and anticipate and manage risks all on a single, intuitive, and robust interface inspired by spreadsheets.

Simetrik has established itself as a market leader in Latin America, handling two-thirds of the region’s transactions. Its clientele includes prominent institutions such as PayU, Mercado Libre, Rappi, PagSeguro, Falabella, Oxxo, Itaú, and Nubank, and partnerships with leading firms like Deloitte. Expanding its international reach, Simetrik has also successfully penetrated key Asian markets, serving clients in India and Singapore. The company's global footprint spans over 35 countries, monitoring over 200 million records daily.

About the role

Simetrik is looking for an Account Executive based in São Paulo to lead our Enterprise expansion in Brazil. This role is all about building and converting a high-quality pipeline with strategic accounts in the financial and payments ecosystem. You will operate as a true hunter: opening doors, mapping stakeholders, designing a winning strategy and driving complex deals to close, while building long-term relationships that help us scale in the region.

What does success look like in this role?

  • Consistently generate and manage a strong pipeline of qualified Enterprise opportunities in Brazil.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first contact to signed contract, with a disciplined, methodical approach.
  • Become a trusted advisor for senior decision makers in banks, fintechs and enterprises, positioning Simetrik as a strategic partner.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (Product, Delivery, Partnerships, Marketing) to unlock and accelerate deals.
  • Show clear, measurable impact on new revenue, deal velocity and quality of opportunities.

What is the impact and scope of this position?

This role is central to taking Simetrik “to the next level” in Brazil. You will:

  • Be directly responsible for opening and growing our most strategic Enterprise accounts in the country.
  • Leverage your network, market knowledge and sales expertise to position Simetrik against global and local competitors in financial automation and reconciliation.
  • Influence our go-to-market motion, pricing conversations and account strategy in one of our key growth markets.
  • Represent Simetrik externally in high-stakes conversations with C-level and senior leaders across the financial and payments ecosystem.

What are the key responsibilities of this role?

  • Generate, qualify and develop new Enterprise opportunities in the Brazilian market.
  • Maintain an organized, up-to-date pipeline and reliably forecast revenue in your territory.
  • Lead discovery, diagnosis and value-based conversations with multiple stakeholders in complex organizations.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, demos and proposals tailored to each account.
  • Navigate and orchestrate multi-threaded sales cycles, aligning technical, business and executive stakeholders.
  • Negotiate and close high-value contracts, ensuring sustainable and profitable deals.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth handover and successful implementation of new clients.
  • Track and report on key sales metrics, continuously improving your approach based on data and feedback.

Must Have

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on Enterprise or upper mid-market clients.
  • Proven track record as a hunter generating pipeline and closing complex deals in SaaS, technology, fintech or payments.
  • Deep experience managing multi-stakeholder sales processes and long sales cycles.
  • Strong negotiation, persuasion and stakeholder management skills with senior decision makers.
  • Ability to build and maintain a healthy, well-qualified pipeline and manage it with discipline in a CRM (ideally Salesforce).
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, MEDDPICC or similar) and evidence of applying them in practice.
  • High level of autonomy, ownership and self-motivation; comfortable operating in a fast-changing, “startup mode” environment.
  • Excellent communication skills: able to structure complex ideas clearly in conversations and in writing.
  • Comfortable collaborating with remote and cross-functional teams across countries and time zones.
  • Native or fluent Portuguese and strong fluency in English (spoken and written).

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience selling to banks, fintechs, payment companies or financial institutions.
  • Background in companies offering financial automation, reconciliation, ERP, or related enterprise software.
  • Existing network of senior contacts in the Brazilian financial and payments ecosystem.
  • Experience working in high-growth startups or scale-ups, with exposure to “roller coaster” growth environments.
  • Conversational Spanish, to collaborate more easily with teams and clients across LATAM.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least several years in Enterprise/strategic accounts.
  • Solid experience in SaaS, technology, fintech, payments, financial services or adjacent industries.
  • Proven history of meeting or exceeding ambitious sales targets and closing high-value deals.
  • Based in São Paulo with availability to travel to client sites within Brazil when needed.
  • Native/fluent Portuguese, advanced English required; Spanish is a strong plus.

Benefits

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions and competitive salaries.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits, creating and collaborating is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.
  • 500USD a year for you to invest in learning.

title: Especialista

title: Senior Specialist - Strategy, New Business and Corporate Planning

A área tem como foco impulsionar o crescimento e a rentabilidade do Cartão de Crédito por meio da otimização das autorizações de transações, garantindo o equilíbrio entre aprovação, experiência do cliente e controle de risco e fraude. Atuar de forma estratégica no direcionamento das iniciativas da squad, estruturando análises, priorizações e recomendações que apoiem decisões de negócio.

Trabalhar em parceria com times de Crédito, Fraude, Dados e Analytics para garantir alinhamento das estratégias e execução eficiente das iniciativas.

Experiência na condução de projetos analíticos e estratégicos;

Capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos e propor soluções baseadas em dados.

Experiência atuando em squads multidisciplinares.

  • Manage all aspects of a project, including planning, organization, and implementation of project activities

  • Able to perform basic hardware and software hands-on work.

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In:

As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.

The impact you will have:

Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.

Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.

Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.

Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.

Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.

This role is Remote based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Support Specialist

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 

We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?

Key Responsibilities:
  1. Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.

  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  1. Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  1. Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.
Skills & Qualifications:
  • Technical Expertise:
  • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
  • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
  • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
  • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
  • Problem-solving Ability:
  • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Communication Skills:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
  • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
  • Organizational Skills:
  • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Experience:
  • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
  • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:
  • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
  • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
  • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.

Who You Are:

  • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
  • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
  • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
  • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
  • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva, desde a produção de mudas até o óleo refinado, gorduras especiais e produtos de alto valor agregado, incluindo linhas orgânicas.

Atualmente, a empresa conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, empregando cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de duas décadas, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, beneficiando mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e com as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em práticas que tornam a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira.

title: Líder de Equipe Comercial Externo - Mercado Pago - Fortaleza
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.
  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta.
  • Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;

Nós lhe propomos:

description:

  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.

  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

  • Registrar e acompanhar o pipeline em CRM/planilha, com organização e previsibilidade.

  • Comunicação excelente, postura profissional e conforto em lidar com público exigente.

Aqui o padrão é alto: disciplina de follow-up, discrição, linguagem impecável e foco em excelência.

Envie sua candidatura pelo LinkedIn. Se possível, inclua uma breve mensagem sobre sua experiência com atendimento premium e follow-up comercial.

Atuar como SDR (Sales Development Representative) , apoiando o ciclo inicial de vendas, qualificando leads, gerando oportunidades e fortalecendo nossa presença no mercado. A pessoa trabalhará lado a lado com o time comercial, garantindo um fluxo contínuo e saudável de novas oportunidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar corretamente as etapas do funil de vendas: MQL (Marketing Qualified Leads), SAL (Sales Accepted Leads) e SQL (Sales Qualified Leads)
  • Gerar listas de qualificação e prospecção.
  • Desenvolver prospects e leads, promovendo engajamento e avanço no funil.
  • Agendar e apoiar na preparação de reuniões/visitas comerciais.
  • Identificar oportunidades de negócios durante interações com potenciais clientes.
  • Construir relacionamento de longo prazo com clientes, parceiros e fabricantes.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre produtos, soluções e benefícios oferecidos pela Stratesys.
  • Executar rotinas de cadência e manter controle das atividades diárias para geração de KPIs.
  • Utilizar redes sociais (como LinkedIn) para prospecção e influência.
  • Para nível Pleno: apoiar a estruturação de cadências e produzir conteúdos de suporte à área de marketing.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia de Produção, Tecnologia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Até 1 ano de experiência em empresa júnior ou funções comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e CRM.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Inglês e/ou desejável (nível básico).
  • Perfil autogerenciável, motivado e colaborativo.

Informações adicionais:

Modelo de contratação preferencialmente Cooperado.

Disponibilidade e interesse para atuação exclusiva e full time.
